notes: In-app price comparison for laptop parts — no more leaving the app. Hit 'Compare prices in-app' (or Find for THIS PC) and it pulls live prices straight into a sortable list, cheapest first, in-stock first, with the stock status, your sell price alongside each trade price, a Buy button and Add-to-ticket on every row. AJ Parts comes in live and reliably; eBay is attempted (it sometimes blocks apps from reading it, more so on a VPN). Suppliers that can't be read in-app stay as one-click 'open on site' buttons, and a status line tells you exactly which came back and which didn't.
